answer.rationale: In BH3, boron forms three sigma bonds and has no lone pairs, giving a trigonal-planar arrangement and sp2 hybridization. BeH2 is linear (sp), while the central atoms in H3O+ and NH3 each have four electron domains and are sp3 hybridized.
